prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
new_flow changes in adoption and home were helpful, as both produced confirmed winning tests.
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder changes were tested twice each and showed no positive effect or worsened performance.
home, wait_info changes were tested twice and showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific kinds of changes because each has only been tested once.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -3.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Habit Selection Flow: Adds an interactive habit selection flow during adoption where users choose work breaks and companion activity preferences before generating their pet. (why: Adoption step has a 63.3% conversion rate and takes 89s median / 1017s mean. Adding personal habit context improves engagement and relevance before desktop spawn.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Screen Corner Preference Screen: Introduces a new dedicated screen allowing users to pick which corner of their desktop screen the pet will reside in. (why: Support emails report post-onboarding confusion around desktop pet placement and behavior (3 complaints). Setting position early sets expectations.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Greeting Style Selector Flow: Adds a flow screen to let users customize how the pet greets them when launched (energetic wave, subtle purr, or quiet icon). (why: Support mail shows confusion after onboarding regarding pet controls and interactions (3 emails). Introducing greeting styles builds familiarity with controls.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop Pet Activity Schedule Screen: Inserts a screen during adoption for setting sleep hours and active desk times for the desktop companion. (why: Support feedback notes users are unsure how to hide or manage desktop pet presence (3 emails). Pre-setting quiet hours reduces confusion.)
4: [finish, hint] Pet Quick Action Hotkey Hint: Displays a prominent hotkey hint card on the finish screen showing how to hide and call the desktop pet anytime. (why: 3 support tickets raised post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet once setup is finished.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Time Estimate: Enables explicit time estimate count and animated status on the waiting screen while background assets load. (why: Home drop-off step waiting time takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and 3 support emails reported desktop pet loading stalls.)
6: [finish, layout] Finish Screen Quick Controls Checklist: Replaces standard home intro layout with a checklist detailing key interaction gestures before completing setup. (why: Finish screen conversion is 64.8% and takes mean 5815s. Support emails cite confusion on controlling and hiding pet.)
7: [home, notification] Background Loading Desktop Ready Sound Notification: Adds an audio chime option and notification alert on the waiting screen when the companion finishes desktop initialization. (why: Waiting step takes 201s median / 2336s mean. Audio cues notify users who tab away while the pet finishes loading.)
